## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] A test demonstrates the expected behavior.
- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] `testDebugUnitTest`, `lintDebug`, and `assembleDebug` pass where relevant.
- [ ] User-facing Android changes were checked on an emulator or device.

## Privacy and Licensing

- [ ] No credentials, signing files, personal data, backups, or private media are included.
- [ ] New dependencies or content have documented licensing and attribution.
- [ ] Core tracking still works without optional network services.

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation is updated, or no documentation change is required.
